snippet.title: Blitz Smash Ultimate - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
This game rolls roguelite and run and gunner into a tight experience with 1-4 couch co-op. Combine bullet powers found on the field to create unique bullet types. Dash to avoid attacks but also to crash enemies or deflect bullets.

Releases on 30th September 2025

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3981420/Blitz_Smash_Ultimate/
Playstation Store: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014209
